name: Bug report
description: Report something that is broken or behaves incorrectly.
labels: ["bug"]
---

## Summary

A short description of what is wrong.

## Environment

- Goyo version: (Settings → About, or the release tag you are running)
- Install method: (prebuilt release, `pnpm dev:desktop`, custom build)
- Operating system and version: (e.g. macOS 15.4, Windows 11 23H2, Ubuntu 24.04)
- Architecture: (Apple Silicon, Intel x86_64, ARM64, etc.)
- Sync mode: (Local-only / Self-hosted Worker / Goyo Cloud)
- If Self-hosted Worker: Cloudflare region and Worker version
- If Goyo Cloud: hosted endpoint reachable? (yes/no)

## Steps to reproduce

1. ...
2. ...
3. ...

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include screenshots or short screen recordings if
they help.

## Logs

Paste relevant logs here. **Do not include private writing content or
sync tokens.** Redact bearer tokens, login codes, email addresses, and
document bodies.

```text
(paste here)
```

## Impact

How bad is the bug? Pick one and explain in a sentence.

- [ ] Blocker: cannot use the app or have lost data
- [ ] Major: a core flow is broken but there is a workaround
- [ ] Minor: a small annoyance or cosmetic issue

## Possible cause (optional)

If you have an idea what is going on, share it. Linking to relevant code is
appreciated.
